pages.summary: 7-phase IR runbook (Detect/Triage/Contain/Eradicate/Recover/PIR/Disclose) with SEV1-SEV4 severity model, 5-min MTTA / 30-min MTTR targets. BFT-gated containment (q_mcp 17/33, rotate_keys 23/33, q_agent 17/33, q_region 23/33, lockdown 27/33, escrow_veto 23/33). Sovereign threat intel from NCSC CiSP (UK-only), zero US feeds (Mandiant/CrowdStrike/MS TI rejected). Forensic capture with 7-year retention, RFC3161 timestamps, OSA s7 admissible evidence. War-room on Element/Matrix + PagerDuty EU + Signal sovereign-only. 7 immutable red lines including human-always-wins invariant. Compliance cross-walk UK GDPR Art 33 (72h ICO notification), NCSC CIR scheme, JSP 440 Ch 7 (14-day defence report), JSP 936 §5, EU AI Act Art 73, NIST SP 800-61 Rev 3, ISO/IEC 27035-1:2023, NCSC CAF C2.

Sovereign-only Certificate Authority with 1 Root CA (offline, air-gapped UK safe), 3 Intermediate CAs (Ring0/Ring1/Ring2 online BFT-gated), 30 end-entity certs (30-day validity). Ed25519-only signing (RSA rejected for new). 3 pin strategies: SPKI hash (recommended), full-cert SHA-256 (strictest), TUF delegated (peer-federation). HPKE RFC 9180 application-layer encryption (X25519 + HKDF-SHA256 + ChaCha20-Poly1305) for defence-in-depth against TLS termination. CT log on SIGIL ledger with 7-year retention, Merkle-anchored, replicated. 90-day Intermediate rotation, 30-day end-entity rotation, 10-year Root CA validity. BFT-gated Root CA ops: 27/33 + human witness for Root key rotation, 23/33 for Intermediate issuance. 7 anti-patterns with auto-quarantine including: no WebPKI CAs, no US HSMs, no RSA new, mandatory CT logging, mandatory attestation tokens. Compliance: NCSC SC-01 CAF B3, UK GDPR Art 32, DPA 2018 Sch 1, JSP 440 Ch 7, JSP 936 §4, EU AI Act Art 15, NIST SP 800-52 Rev 2, RFC 9180, RFC 6962.

3-layer sovereign CSP defence: (L1) per-request nonces + SHA-384 hashes + strict-dynamic with sovereign trust anchors; (L2) zero-US-script policy banning jsdelivr/unpkg/cdnjs/googleapis CDN, all scripts bundled or sovereign-hosted with Ed25519 signature; (L3) Trusted Types sovereign-policy with DOMPurify sanitization, rejecting non-sovereign script URLs. 7 bypass vectors blocked: nonce reuse, JSONP endpoints, wildcard domains, US CDNs, inline event handlers, CSS-based exfiltration (background: url, @font-face), DOM-based XSS via innerHTML. CSP reporting to /csp-endpoint with SIGIL emission. SRI SHA-384 integrity on all bundled scripts with crossorigin=anonymous mandatory. 8 anti-patterns: no 'unsafe-inline', no 'unsafe-eval', no wildcard domains, no US CDNs, mandatory SRI, mandatory crossorigin, mandatory CSP header, mandatory Trusted Types. Compliance: NCSC SC-01 CAF B3, OWASP ASVS V5 L3, OWASP Top 10 A03:2021 (XSS), W3C Trusted Types TR, UK GDPR Art 32, NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 SI-10, EU AI Act Art 15.
